(#{userId}, #{roleId}, NOW(), '0')
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.open_id, u.password, u.user_type, u.avatar, u.nick_name, u.email, u.real_name, u.mobile, u.sex, u.data_state, u.dept_no, u.post_no, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.remark, u.create_by, u.update_by, u.is_leader, u.is_delete, d.dept_name, p.post_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.data_state = '0' AND r.data_state = '0') AS role_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_no = d.dept_no LEFT JOIN sys_post p ON u.post_no = p.post_no WHERE u.id = #{id}
